name: kicad-thai
description: KiCad PCB design skills for the Thai electronics industry: ERC/DRC with fab rule presets, one-command Gerber/BOM/CPL export for JLCPCB, PCBWay and Thai fabs, TISI (มอก.) and NBTC (กสทช.) compliance checklists, Thai sourcing and Thai silkscreen. ออกแบบ PCB ด้วย KiCad สำหรับอุตสาหกรรมไทย

interface.displayName: KiCad Thai ลายวงจร
interface.shortDescription: ออกแบบ PCB ด้วย KiCad: ตรวจ DRC, ส่งโรงงาน, มอก./กสทช.
interface.longDescription: KiCad 8/9/10 skills for Thai engineers: run ERC/DRC against JLCPCB/PCBWay/Thai-fab rule presets, export a fab-ready Gerber zip plus BOM and pick-and-place files in one command, review designs for DFM, check TISI (มอก.) and NBTC (กสทช.) requirements, find parts and fabs in Thailand, and put Thai text on the silkscreen.
